subject: Chemistry
title: Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers
summary: Alcohols (R–OH) aur phenols (Ar–OH) mein –OH group hai; ether (R–O–R′) mein oxygen do carbons ke beech. Hydrogen bonding alcohols aur phenols ko high boiling point aur thodi water solubility deti hai.
Phenols alcohols se kaafi zyada acidic hain kyunki phenoxide ion resonance se stable hai; ortho/para par electron-withdrawing groups (–NO₂) phenol ko aur acidic banate hain.
Alcohols O–H todkar (acidic nature, esterification) ya C–O todkar (substitution, dehydration) react karte hain. Lucas test primary, secondary aur tertiary alcohols ko alag karta hai.
–OH group phenol ki benzene ring ko electrophilic substitution ke liye bahut activate karta hai (bromine water se 2,4,6-tribromophenol). Named reactions: Kolbe, Reimer–Tiemann, Williamson synthesis.

formulas.name: Alcohols from alkenes
formulas.formula: acid-catalysed hydration (Markovnikov);  hydroboration–oxidation (B₂H₆ then H₂O₂/OH⁻) gives anti-Markovnikov alcohols

formulas.name: Alcohols from carbonyls
formulas.formula: RCHO + H₂/Ni or NaBH₄/LiAlH₄ → 1° alcohol;  R₂CO → 2° alcohol;  RCOOH + LiAlH₄ → 1° alcohol

formulas.name: Grignard route
formulas.formula: HCHO + RMgX → 1° alcohol;  other aldehydes → 2°;  ketones → 3° (after hydrolysis)
formulas.when: Naye C–C bonds ke saath alcohols banana.

formulas.name: Acidity order
formulas.mistake: Electron-donating groups (–CH₃) phenol ki acidity GHATAATE hain; electron-withdrawing (–NO₂) badhaate hain — ulta mat lo.

formulas.name: Lucas test
formulas.formula: conc. HCl + anhydrous ZnCl₂:  3° turbidity immediately;  2° within ~5 min;  1° only on heating

formulas.name: Dehydration of alcohols
formulas.formula: conc. H₂SO₄ heat: ethanol → ethene (443 K) or diethyl ether (413 K);  ease 3° > 2° > 1°
formulas.mistake: Temperature product tay karta hai: zyada par alkene, kam par ether — mix mat karo.

formulas.name: Oxidation of alcohols
formulas.formula: 1° → aldehyde (PCC) → acid (KMnO₄);  2° → ketone;  3° resist oxidation;  Cu at 573 K: 1° → aldehyde, 2° → ketone, 3° → alkene
formulas.when: Products se alcohol ka type pehchaanna.

formulas.name: Phenol preparation
formulas.formula: cumene process (cumene → cumene hydroperoxide → phenol + acetone);  from diazonium salts (warm water);  from chlorobenzene (Dow's process)

formulas.name: Kolbe's reaction
formulas.formula: sodium phenoxide + CO₂ (4–7 atm, 400 K), then H⁺ → salicylic acid

formulas.name: Reimer–Tiemann reaction
formulas.formula: phenol + CHCl₃ + aq. NaOH, then H⁺ → salicylaldehyde

formulas.name: Bromination of phenol
formulas.formula: bromine water → 2,4,6-tribromophenol (white ppt);  Br₂ in CS₂ (low temperature) → o- and p-bromophenol

formulas.name: Williamson synthesis
formulas.mistake: 1° alkyl halide lo — 3° halides ke saath elimination (alkene) haavi hota hai, ether nahi banta.

formulas.name: Cleavage of ethers by HI
formulas.formula: R–O–CH₃ + HI → R–OH + CH₃I (I⁻ attacks the less hindered carbon);  anisole + HI → phenol + CH₃I
formulas.mistake: Aryl–O bond kabhi nahi toot-ta: anisole se phenol banta hai, iodobenzene nahi.

examples.title: Grignard synthesis
examples.problem: Kaunsa carbonyl compound aur Grignard reagent 2-methylpropan-2-ol dega?
examples.solution: Acetone + CH₃MgBr, phir hydrolysis → (CH₃)₃COH (ketone se 3° alcohol).

examples.title: Acidity
examples.solution: p-Nitrophenol > phenol > p-cresol > ethanol (–NO₂ phenoxide ko stable karta hai; –CH₃ destabilise; ethoxide mein resonance nahi).

examples.title: Lucas test
examples.problem: Teen alcohols turbidity dete hain: ek turant, ek 5 minute baad, ek sirf garam karne par. Types?
examples.solution: Turant: tertiary (2-methylpropan-2-ol); ~5 min: secondary (butan-2-ol); garam karne par: primary (butan-1-ol).

examples.title: Steam volatility
examples.problem: o-Nitrophenol steam volatile kyun hai par p-nitrophenol nahi?
examples.solution: o-Nitrophenol mein intramolecular hydrogen bonding hai, isliye molecules aapas mein nahi judte. p-Nitrophenol intermolecular H-bonds banata hai jo boiling point badhaate hain.

examples.title: Ether cleavage
examples.solution: Phenol + methyl iodide. O–aryl bond partial double bond jaisa hai, isliye I⁻ methyl carbon par attack karta hai.

examples.title: Williamson choice
examples.problem: tert-Butyl methyl ether banane ke liye kaunsa pair: (CH₃)₃CBr + CH₃ONa ya CH₃Br + (CH₃)₃CONa?
examples.solution: CH₃Br + (CH₃)₃CONa. Strong base ke saath 3° halide elimination karke isobutylene dega.

topics.title: Classification and structure
topics.explain: Alcohols: monohydric, dihydric, trihydric; primary, secondary, tertiary; allylic aur benzylic. Alcohols mein O sp³, C–O–H angle tetrahedral se thoda kam; phenols mein C–O bond chhota (partial double-bond character).

topics.title: Physical properties
topics.explain: Alcohols ke boiling points same mass ke hydrocarbons aur ethers se kaafi zyada (hydrogen bonding); branching se ghat-te hain. Chhote alcohols paani mein mil jaate hain; alkyl hissa badhne par solubility ghatti hai.

topics.title: Reactions of the O–H bond
topics.explain: Alcohols active metals (Na) se H₂ aur alkoxides dete hain, aur acids, anhydrides ya acid chlorides se esters (esterification). Phenol NaOH se bhi react karta hai (alcohols nahi), yaani uski acidic nature zyada strong hai.

topics.title: Electrophilic substitution of phenol
topics.explain: –OH ring ko ortho/para par activate karta hai. Dilute HNO₃ se nitration → o- aur p-nitrophenol; concentrated HNO₃ → picric acid (2,4,6-trinitrophenol). Conc. H₂SO₄ se sulphonation kam temperature par o-phenolsulphonic acid aur zyada par p-isomer. Chromic acid se oxidation → benzoquinone.

topics.title: Mechanism of dehydration
topics.explain: –OH ka protonation, paani nikal kar carbocation (slow step), phir H⁺ nikal kar alkene. Carbocation banne ki wajah se aasaani tertiary > secondary > primary aur rearrangements ho sakte hain.

topics.title: Commercially important alcohols
topics.explain: Methanol (wood spirit) zehreela: andhapan aur maut. Ethanol cheeni ke fermentation (invertase, zymase) se; denatured alcohol CuSO₄ aur pyridine milakar peene layak nahi rakhte.

topics.title: Ethers
topics.explain: Williamson synthesis ya alcohols ke dehydration se. Kam polar, isomeric alcohols se kam boiling point. Anisole mein –OR ring ko activate karta hai (o/p-directing) halogenation, nitration aur Friedel–Crafts ke liye.

ratta: Ethanol + H₂SO₄: 443 K ethene, 413 K ether.
Williamson: 1° halide + alkoxide;  anisole + HI → phenol + CH₃I.
